"[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" is a pretty good card for an Imperial space deck. Since your "[[Executor]]" has only 2 hyperspeed and your "Star Destroyers" have only 3 you may have trouble getting "[[Red 5]]" or other fast starships so you play "[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" All you have to do is get a destiny over one and its hyperspeed is reduced to zero. Now you take two turns to catch up with them and you with two or three "Star Destroyers" completely overpower them. It can also stop "[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] Runs."

A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ivelostartoo-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[I've Lost Artoo! (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 6 August 2016): The game text is reworded: “Use 1 Force to deploy on a starship with a [Nav Computer] or astromech aboard. Target [Nav Computer] or astromech and draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 1, astromech lost (lose Effect) or [Nav Computer] is canceled (may add 1 astromech); otherwise, Effect lost.” As a slip it again has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip, and the bronze disc is gone.

The same area of the disc card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
